liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Devil With The Blue Dress On** (3 reviews): The Devil into Good Golly Miss Molly and back to Devil sequence sounds good on this soundboard; Devil into Good Golly Miss Molly and back is something no other band could pull off in a 20,000-capacity shed in 1987 [12][16][18]
- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the opening Jack Straw strong; Jack Straw opener is punchy [12][18]
- **When Push Comes To Shove** (1 review): Jerry sings Push with more enthusiasm than usual, making it less skippable [13]
- **Desolation Row** (1 review): Reviewer calls Desolation typical, since it was a strong tune in 1987 [13]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Reviewer cites powerful, high-energy singing in Not Fade Away as evidence the band knew the show was good [14]
- **Drums** (1 other source): Drums leads into a jam before I Need A Miracle [1]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd87-10-04 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-10-04 t02 Jack Straw**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-10-04 t03 When Push Comes To Shove**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-10-04 t04 Walkin' Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-10-04 t05 High Time**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-10-04 t06 Desolation Row**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-10-04 t07 Iko Iko**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]
- **gd87-10-04 t08 Hell In A Bucket**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-10-04.142334.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 130 min [1]
- **gd1987-10-04.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83907.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 130 min; rated 4.33/5 by 6 [4]
- **gd1987-10-04.sbd.gmb.79381.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 125 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [5]. Said about its sound: Reviewer judges this matrix the best-sounding of five or six archive sources, with a nice groove and fantastic sound [17]
- **gd1987-10-04.165070.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 130 min [7]
- **gd87-10-04.sbd.bertha-ashley.7996.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 121 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [10]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the soundboard has great sound quality [15]

## Around the show

- Reviewer attended this first run at Shoreline; calls the show pretty standard with a short first set [18]
- Reviewer reports the whole second set is mislabeled in the track listing [21]
- Reviewer says the second set is entirely mislabeled and takes a long time to reorder [23]
- Encore was moved to the end of the first set to fit the show onto two discs [4]
- Reviewer sees it as a very good summer 1987 show, with strong vocals, especially Bobby songs, but playing just short of great [15]
- Blue Dress into Good Golly is nice but was done better at the 9/9/87 show [15]
- Reviewer notes the first set and the show overall were short [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-10-04.142334.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]
- **gd1987-10-04.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83907.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90) D [4]. Also: Audience recording supplied by David Minches; tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [4]
- **gd1987-10-04.sbd.gmb.79381.sbeok.flac16**: taped by DAT kindly provided for transfer by B.Koucky, rec'd from B.Fried in 1996.; transferred by Chris Ladner, Bill Koucky, Bruce Fried; source: Healy Matrix SBD > PCM > DAT (48KHz)> DAT. [5]. Also: Described as the only lineaged lossless source free of digital audio errors in circulation at seeding; seeded by Green Mountain Bros in October 2006 [5]
- **gd1987-10-04.165070.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Joani Walker -- Tapes supplied by Paul Scotton; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 24, 2023; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MX90) [7]. Also: Tapes supplied by Paul Scotton, with the Oade Brothers and Blake Jacobs providing the patch source; Joe B. Jones supplied pitch correction settings; this is a 24-bit/96k to 16-bit/44.1k transfer [7]
- **gd87-10-04.sbd.bertha-ashley.7996.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> MC> DAT> CDA> WAV> SHN> DAW (Bertha)> CDA [10]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead BGP Staff Laminate Designs, Front](https://www.dead.net/archives/1987/clippings/bgp-staff-laminate-designs-front) [25]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Shoreline Amphitheatre - October 4, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/october-4-1987) [26]
